_doc: Who the Hollowed were before the Bloom, by place (ADR-0028, PopulationDef). A building names one with its PoiDef 'population' (a sleeper entry may name its own), a region with 'population' in region.json. Per enemy type, the bodies (character models, tools/assetgen/blender_catalogs/characters.py) its Hollowed wear, weighted; types not listed (and every special) keep their own bodies. 'mix' is the share that wear the population's bodies: the rest are visitors in their own clothes.

defs.name: Tamsin Valley Clinic
defs.description: Cordon Medical's isolation ward: patients in gowns and wristbands, and the staff who stayed with them.

defs.name: St. Ansel's congregation
defs.description: The congregation that stayed in the pews: Sunday shirts and ties, good dresses and cardigans.

defs.name: Cordon crews
defs.description: The Cordon's work crews and checkpoint staff: coveralls, hi-vis vests with retroreflective tape, hard hats.

defs.name: Timber crews
defs.description: The valley's loggers and mill hands: flannel, denim, suspenders and hard hats.

defs.name: Hunters and trappers
defs.description: Hunting season never ended: blaze orange, buffalo-check wool, canvas.

defs.name: The Ashen
defs.description: Taken in the high timber despite the ash: hides and furs, lichen-ash smeared over the skin, painted faces, bone charms.
